rowJSON.name: CAKE1 · Eco supercakes · January 2026
rowJSON.notes: CAKE1: 8 eco cakes × 200 × 5 kg (1 600 cakes, 8 t) in January 2026. 9 confectioners found by OR-Tools CP-SAT (Early 6 + Late 3), 24 purchase orders (46,427 EUR), orders 2+ days before delivery, last cake packed Fri 30 Jan 17:15. Documentation: documentation/CAKE1/INIT_STAGE.html. Times are the local plant time (hours and minutes are in the columns Hour S / Min S / Hour F / Min F and in From / To).

rowJSON.taskDescription: WORKFORCE & ROSTER
rowJSON.notes: 9 confectioners (found by OR-Tools CP-SAT: Early crew 6, Late crew 3) + 1 purchasing manager + 2 warehouse keepers. Shifts: Early 06:00-14:00 (breaks 08:00-08:15 rest, 10:00-10:30 lunch, 12:00-12:15 rest) and Late 14:00-22:00 (breaks 16:00-16:15 rest, 18:00-18:30 lunch, 20:00-20:15 rest).
